text: Vendor agrees to defend, indemnify, and hold harmless Customer from any claims, damages, liabilities, and expenses arising out of any breach, without limitation or cap on liability.
risk_factors: Overly broad indemnity trigger covering any breach
recommendation: Insert a 12-month trailing fee liability cap and restrict indemnity to gross negligence or intellectual property infringement.

text: Customer reserves the right to terminate this agreement immediately upon notice without cause, without obligation to compensate Provider for completed work in progress.
risk_factors: Forfeiture of fees for work already performed
recommendation: Require 30 days prior written notice and ensure pro-rata payment for services delivered up to effective termination date.

text: Consultant agrees not to provide software engineering or consulting services to any entity worldwide for a duration of 36 months following termination.
risk_factors: Worldwide geographic scope is judicially unenforceable
recommendation: Limit duration to 6-12 months and restrict geographic scope to specific defined direct competitors.

text: All invoices are due Net 30 days. Disputed charges must be identified in writing within 15 days of invoice receipt.
risk_factors: Standard commercial terms with reasonable dispute window
